name: convergence-takeover-circuit-breaker
title: Freeze runaway stories with a convergence + takeover circuit breaker and graduated human ack
description: B-f458 burned ~14 hours in a non-converging death loop (89 advances, 131:31 review run/pass, 65 lease takeovers) because the framework has soft convergence advisories but no hard brake. Add a circuit breaker that derives advance-count / review-pass-rate / takeover-frequency counters read-only from story.events and, on a pathological signature, hard-stops the runaway loop; it auto-recovers once so healthy autonomous work is unaffected, and only escalates to a human-ack freeze on re-trip. Scope is death-loop root causes 1 (takeover storm) and 2 (no convergence fuse); the milestone_ledger_set blocker-hint and review_pass_set writer-identity gaps are owned by concurrent stories and excluded.
